commands.label: Show code actions
commands.description: Shows the quick fixes and refactorings available at the cursor or for the selection.
examples: Cursor on a class name that is not imported: gra → choose the import
Visual selection, then SPC c q → actions for the selected code
commands.rationale: Neovim 0.11 maps gra to code actions. Only Doom Emacs and LazyVim use SPC c a, so the leader key is SPC c q: q for quick fix.

deviation.shadows: Vim gr{char} (replace virtual characters), which neither VSCodeVim nor IdeaVim implements
deviation.note: Clashes with the opt-in ReplaceWithRegister gr and grr (VSCodeVim vim.replaceWithRegister, IdeaVim ReplaceWithRegister).

commands.label: Rename symbol
commands.description: Renames the symbol under the cursor and updates every reference to it.
examples: Cursor on total, grn, type sum, Enter → every use is renamed
commands.rationale: Neovim 0.11 maps grn to rename; Doom Emacs and LazyVim use SPC c r.

deviation.shadows: Vim gr{char} (replace virtual characters), which neither VSCodeVim nor IdeaVim implements
deviation.note: Clashes with the opt-in ReplaceWithRegister gr and grr (VSCodeVim vim.replaceWithRegister, IdeaVim ReplaceWithRegister).

commands.label: Format file or selection
commands.description: Formats the whole file, or only the selection in Visual mode, with the IDE formatter.
examples: SPC c f → the file is reformatted
vip, then SPC c f → only that paragraph
commands.rationale: Doom Emacs and LazyVim use SPC c f to format the region or the whole buffer.

commands.label: Show documentation
commands.description: Shows the documentation and type of the symbol under the cursor.
examples: Cursor on a method call, K → its documentation appears
commands.rationale: Neovim and LazyVim use K for hover documentation; IdeaVim's K already shows it.

semantics.vscodevim: VSCodeVim has no K of its own (it shows the hover with gh), so K is mapped to the hover.
semantics.ideavim: Uses IdeaVim's own K, which opens the Quick Documentation popup.

deviation.shadows: Vim K (look up the word under the cursor with keywordprg)
deviation.origin: Neovim LSP default mapping; built into IdeaVim
deviation.note: Only VS Code maps K; IntelliJ runs IdeaVim's own K.
